notes: §1985:XV.2.1.2 prints SOURCE-COMPUTER. [ computer-name [ WITH DEBUGGING MODE ] . ], WITH optional and DEBUGGING MODE required, hung off a required computer-name. The grammar's sourceComputerParagraph admits debuggingModeClause (WITH? DEBUGGING MODE) only after computerName; VersionConformancePass.VisitDebuggingModeClause gates it (obsolete 2002 COBOL0903, removed 2014) and passes it silently at 85, and DebuggingLineRewriter.Rewrite and DataBinder.BindDeclarations read the clause as the compile-time switch. Probes at --std 85: 'X DEBUGGING MODE' and an empty 'SOURCE-COMPUTER.' compile; a name-less 'WITH DEBUGGING MODE' and 'DEBUGGING MODE', 'WITH DEBUGGING' without MODE, 'WITH MODE', the clause written twice, the clause in OBJECT-COMPUTER, a missing final period (COBOL3408) and a second SOURCE-COMPUTER paragraph are each refused; the witness keeps its D lines as source under the switch.

next.reason: 1985: "SOURCE-COMPUTER. [ computer-name [ WITH DEBUGGING MODE ] . ]"; 2023: "SOURCE-COMPUTER. [ computer-name-1 ] . (FMT-12.3.5.2 has no WITH DEBUGGING MODE phrase)". The 2023 SOURCE-COMPUTER format covers the paragraph but drops the WITH DEBUGGING MODE phrase, so the Debug module's switch is removed.
